data.title: 圣路易斯 · 敞篷跑车后的微风私约
data.action: 背靠着跑车真皮座椅侧过身，一手搭在车门上，一手拨弄着浅蓝波浪长卷发，紫罗兰眼眸饱含深情与暗示，丰腴饱满的尤物身段在薄衫下一览无余。
data.location: 海滨沿海公路观景停车点，远处是繁星点点的港区夜景与平静浪潮
data.timeOfDay: 午夜兜风后的私密停车时光
data.lighting: 车内氛围灯的淡紫冷光与远方港湾灯火在车窗镀膜上反射出朦胧的流光溢彩
data.mood: 绝对成熟诱人的都市佳人魅力，温柔从容又极具侵略性的成人罗曼史
data.description: 海滨沿海公路观景停车点，远处是繁星点点的港区夜景与平静浪潮。背靠着跑车真皮座椅侧过身，一手搭在车门上，一手拨弄着浅蓝波浪长卷发，紫罗兰眼眸饱含深情与暗示，丰腴饱满的尤物身段在薄衫下一览无余。 她微微抬眸轻语——“指挥官，兜风结束了……但夜晚才刚刚开始呢。把车窗摇上去吧，接下来的时间……只属于我们两个人。”
data.promptProse: Parked at a quiet coastal overlook overlooking the glittering port lights at midnight, St. Louis turns sideways against the plush leather seat of a sports car in an ice-blue watered-silk slip gown with a plunging V-neckline and sheer side panels. Resting one arm along the car door frame while brushing her fingers lightly through her hair, she meets the viewer's eyes with a languid, inviting smile. Soft violet cabin ambient light blends with distant harbor reflections across the dark car window.
data.animaCaption: Turned sideways on the sports car's leather seat in a plunging ice-blue watered-silk slip gown, St. Louis rests one arm on the door and brushes her hair with an inviting smile. Soft violet cabin light mixes with distant harbor lights outside the window.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an ice-blue watered-silk slip gown with a deep plunging V-neckline and sheer gossamer side panels clinging smoothly to her curves.
